limits: 29 independently verified constrained tool workflows (prior 27 + bounded TCP discovery x2); full functional coverage of 328 tools remains incomplete.

Bounded TCP discovery (masscan_high_speed/rustscan_fast_scan) uses RedVector's own bounded Python TCP connect() engine, NOT native Masscan or RustScan (neither is installed and no external scanner binary is executed). Limits: 1..128 explicit ports, <=64 concurrent connections, 1s per-connect timeout, 20s deadline, scope-pinned numeric target; no raw sockets, UDP, OS detection, banners or high-speed/internet-scale rates.

Confined HTTP assessment (httpx_probe/nikto_scan/wafw00f_scan/jaeles_vulnerability_scan) performs ONE pinned, TLS-verified, no-redirect root GET and reports only observed response evidence; not full native httpx/Nikto/Wafw00f/Jaeles and runs no external scanner binary.
Nuclei covers two passive root-response header checks; no arbitrary CVE/active templates.
Nmap active service profile covers SSH/HTTP/FTP/SMTP/POP3/IMAP/MySQL greeting evidence, up to 128 explicit ports; NSE/UDP/OS detection and stealth timing remain outside it.
Artifact profile: operator-selected regular files only (1 byte..4 MiB), bounded output/time; strings/objdump/readelf facts and Python hex only.

Runtime profile is read-only; pause/resume/terminate_process and delete_file keep working legacy Flask routes but are intentionally NOT enabled through the reviewed adapters and remain high-impact restricted.
Advisory profile samples anonymous NVD publications (1..168h, <=100 records); not global threat trends, exploitability or target applicability.

Real-model Ollama acceptance was not rerun this pass; no operator model was configured in this environment (test_ollama_assessment_model_live skipped). The final_real_model record predates the current source re-freeze.
All assessment/scan traffic was to test-owned loopback listeners except the advisory test, which read the official public NVD endpoint. Existing backends were not stopped/reconfigured.
